```{python}
#| label: fig-layout-common-centroid
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Common-centroid arrangements of two matched devices A and B, each split into two halves: (a) cross-coupled 2×2 arrangement and (b) linear ABBA arrangement. In both cases, the centroids of A and B coincide, so a linear process gradient (illustrated by the color wedge) affects both devices equally."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

CA, CB = '#64a0e8', '#e57373'

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(6.8, 6.4),
                        gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [4.6, 3.6]})

# gradient background helper
def gradient(ax, x0, x1, y0, y1):
    g = np.linspace(0, 1, 100).reshape(1, -1)
    ax.imshow(g, extent=[x0, x1, y0, y1], origin='lower', aspect='auto',
              cmap='YlOrBr', alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

# (a) cross-coupled
ax = axs[0]
gradient(ax, -0.3, 4.3, -0.3, 4.3)
cells = [(0, 2, 'A', CA), (2, 2, 'B', CB), (0, 0, 'B', CB), (2, 0, 'A', CA)]
for x, y, t, c in cells:
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x + 0.1, y + 0.1), 1.8, 1.8, fc=c, ec='k',
                           lw=1.0, zorder=2))
    ax.text(x + 1.0, y + 1.0, t, fontsize=13, ha='center', va='center',
            zorder=3)
ax.set_title('(a) cross-coupled', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 4.3); ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 4.3)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')

# (b) linear ABBA
ax = axs[1]
gradient(ax, -0.3, 8.3, 0.4, 2.6)
for i, (t, c) in enumerate([('A', CA), ('B', CB), ('B', CB), ('A', CA)]):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((i * 2 + 0.1, 0.6), 1.8, 1.8, fc=c, ec='k',
                           lw=1.0, zorder=2))
    ax.text(i * 2 + 1.0, 1.5, t, fontsize=13, ha='center', va='center',
            zorder=3)
ax.set_title('(b) linear (ABBA)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 8.3); ax.set_ylim(-0.4, 3.2)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
